exclusions.reason: The current official non-degree guide and 2025 enrollment evidence confirm only the already-published Tibetan-language general-study program. No second concrete, individually applicable international program or school-specific scholarship was located on an official page, so no placeholder was added.

QHU's official form verifies three non-degree application categories, but the current website does not publish concrete degree-major names or a QHU-specific current scholarship route. Generic national scholarship information was not misrepresented as a QHU award.

The current 2026 undergraduate page is protected by a JavaScript challenge. Historical official curricula support five durable graduate program identities, while current fees, dates and scholarship claims remain quarantined.

notes: CQUPT gains five international graduate identities from its official curriculum; no current cycle or fee is inferred.
HRBNU gains long- and short-term international course identities plus two official scholarship identities.
Ningxia University gains four degree identities across bachelor, master and doctorate plus three applicable scholarship identities.
Qinghai University gains three individually selectable non-degree study/research categories without guessed majors or fees.
Shandong Normal University gains three explicit international degree identities and two scholarships, including the closed 2026 Shandong award.
Shihezi University gains two 2026-evidenced international master's identities and two applicable scholarship routes.
Sichuan Normal University gains four programs and a currently open scholarship cycle for eligible March 2027 categories.
Tibet University remains at one verified public program because no second official individually applicable identity was found.
